## Executive Summary

The .so ccTLD is currently served by 2 authoritative
nameservers. 2 of 2
authoritative nameservers support IPv6 connectivity, resulting in an IPv6 enablement
rate of 100.0%. The authoritative DNS infrastructure is
distributed across 2 distinct Autonomous Systems, improving
resilience against network and routing failures.

According to Cloudflare Radar (1.1.1.1 public resolver traffic), 1.77% of observed DNS queries resolved to DNSSEC-signed domains and were validated (SECURE), while 92.86% queried unsigned domains (INSECURE). Across major networks, DNSSEC-secured query share ranges from 1.13% to 9.83% (while APNIC/Pulse ISP resolver validation capability stands at 87%).
